attempts.summary: Set up a nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data from node2 to /var/backups/inventory on node1, retaining the last 7 days of archives. Fixed a cluster-wide sshd host-key/service issue that blocked all inter-node SSH, then built and verified the end-to-end backup+retention pipeline, and completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes with full recovery confirmed.
